name: @dumbmice/pi-todo-loop
description: Keep pi working while a todo list still has open tasks, and stop when the agent asks for a person.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run pack:check
scripts.pretest: node -e "const [a,b]=process.versions.node.split('.').map(Number); if(a<22||(a===22&&b<6)){console.error('@dumbmice/pi-todo-loop tests need Node >= 22.6, but node '+process.versions.node+' is first in PATH.\nPut a newer node first, for example pi own node:\n  ~/.local/share/pi-node/current/bin'); process.exit(1)}"
